command:
printf 'DEFAULT_TARGET
'; systemctl get-default
printf '
UNIT_FILES
'; systemctl list-unit-files --type=service --type=socket --type=timer --no-pager
printf '
RUNNING_SERVICES
'; systemctl list-units --type=service --state=running --no-pager
printf '
DISPLAY_MANAGER
'; readlink -f /etc/systemd/system/display-manager.service; cat /etc/X11/default-display-manager
printf '
KERNEL_MODULES
'; cat /proc/modules
printf '
BOOT_KERNELS
'; ls -l /boot/Image*; ls -d /lib/modules/*; dpkg-query -W -f='${binary:Package}	${Version}	${db:Status-Abbrev}
' 'linux-image*' 'linux-modules*' 'nvidia-l4t-kernel*' 2>/dev/null
printf '
MODULE_BOOT_CONFIG
'; cat /etc/modules; find /etc/modules-load.d /etc/modprobe.d -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%p
'
printf '
PROJECT_DIRECTORIES
'; find /home/jetson -maxdepth 4 -type d -name .git -printf '%h
' 2>/dev/null
printf '
PKG_CHECK
'; dpkg-query -W -f='${binary:Package}	${Version}	${db:Status-Abbrev}
' build-essential pkg-config cmake git curl ca-certificates libssl-dev libudev-dev libasound2-dev libglib2.0-dev libgstreamer1.0-dev libgstreamer-plugins-base1.0-dev libgstreamer-plugins-bad1.0-dev libsqlite3-dev libclang-dev clang v4l-utils alsa-utils gstreamer1.0-tools gstreamer1.0-alsa gstreamer1.0-plugins-good gstreamer1.0-plugins-bad gstreamer1.0-plugins-base 2>/dev/null
printf '
SYSTEM_PRESSURE
'; free -b; df -B1 /; uptime
printf '
LISTEN_ADDRESSES
'; ss -lnt
